verdict.rationale: Loops publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (openapi.json) and structured API reference docs listing endpoints like /events/send and /contacts/create, which could power an interactive reference, but no evidence shows an actual 'try it out' or runnable-example interface in the docs. missing for 10: explicit interactive/try-it console, live runnable code samples, confirmation the API reference UI executes requests in-browser.
